$comment: Monsters the ring of recoil (and the ring of suffering's recoil) does not damage: OSRS Wiki, Category:Monsters immune to recoil. Matched by NPC name. Left out because the name is shared with monsters that are not immune: Skeleton Hellhound and Greater Skeleton Hellhound (only Vet'ion's and Calvar'ion's), Evil Chicken, Ogre shaman, Bee Swarm, Husk, Parasite, Undead tree. Hespori sets its own immunity attribute.
